Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner introduced an unjustified fallback rule to assume Emperor Zhang of Han’s birthplace as the imperial clan’s ancestral commandery (Nanyang, Henan) if a source didn’t explicitly state it. This speculative shortcut is incorrect (Emperor Zhang is typically recorded as being born in Luoyang) and would lead to a wrong answer. It diverted the process from properly retrieving the explicit birthplace from reliable sources and set the team up to report an erroneous location.
